what_it_does: Scope modifiers narrow an API scope to a subset of its operations, such as clusters:read for read operations or sql:restricted query for read only SQL queries, in personal access tokens, OAuth secrets, and OAuth token requests. A scope modifier narrows an API scope to a subset of its operations. To add a modifier, append it to the scope name after a colon, for example clusters:read.
why_it_matters: Reduces operational overhead and unlocks new capabilities for data teams on Databricks.
plain_summary: Scope modifiers narrow an API scope to a subset of its operations, such as clusters:read for read operations or sql:restricted query for read only SQL queries, in personal access tokens, OAuth secrets, and OAuth token requests.
